laHarpar.title: La Harpar Discovered!
laHarpar.body: A fishing village lies nearby. The Map tab is now available — use it to travel there. Once inside, visit the Tavern for rumors, browse the Market for supplies, and seek out the Exploration Guild for bounty tasks.

mawood.title: Mawood Discovered!
mawood.body: Smoke and lantern-light flicker between the towering Silverwood Spires — a town built on platforms high above the forest floor. Travel there from the Map. Elder Corwin will want a word, and Sylvie, Finn and Brenna all have work for a capable fighter.

lirold.title: Lirold Discovered!
lirold.body: From the Matriarch’s nest you can see past the mountains: a road winding south off the Pass, and at its end stone walls and a castle under the mountains. Lirold, the capital of Port Stocksmar. Travel there from the Map; its Arena takes any challenger who can pay the gate.

plains.title: New Area: The Plains
plains.body: Beyond the beach stretches open grassland. Strange slimes roam the fields — and something much larger lurks at wave 10. Survive long enough to face the boss.

elderwoodWilds.title: New Area: Elderwood Wilds
elderwoodWilds.body: Past the Mountain Pass the trees close in and the sky disappears. Forest spiders, gnoll war-bands and blighted saplings prowl the outer rim. Push deeper — the town of Mawood lies just ahead.

camp.title: Camp Set Up!
camp.body: That turtle shell is too good to leave on the sand. You pitch a small camp and knock together a Workbench. The Camp tab is now available — craft gear there, and gather stones and sticks to build a Fire Pit for cooking.

skillTree.title: Level Up! Skill Tree Unlocked
skillTree.body: You've grown stronger. The Skill Tree tab is now available — spend your skill points to unlock passive bonuses and sharpen your fighting style.

firePit.title: Fire Pit Built!
firePit.body: A ring of stones and a crackle of dry sticks — your camp finally has a fire. A Cooking tab has appeared in Camp. Grill what the sea gives you; a full belly hits harder.

cookingPot.title: Cooking Upgraded!
cookingPot.body: The trader’s old iron pot hangs over your Fire Pit now. Stews and pies are within reach — Cooking is now Lv 2.

mortarAndPestle.title: Alchemy Unlocked!
mortarAndPestle.body: Sylvie’s spare Mortar & Pestle travels with you now. An Alchemy tab has appeared in Camp — grind herbs and water into potions.

runeAltar.title: Rune Altar Raised!
runeAltar.body: Elarion’s portable altar hums faintly when you set it down. A Rune Altar tab has appeared in Camp — bind raw materials into runes.
